page.overview:
Who is Kinbo?

Kinbo is a boy who lives in Okobore Town of Kuri with his mother Yame and his little brother.

Kinbo is a small boy with round eyes and nose, and dark brown hair which is very short apart from a tuft in the back. He wears a tattered green kimono with yellow patches.

Kinbo was unable to hold back tears due to extreme hunger despite his mother's insistence that Wano Country boys do not complain.

Kinbo and his little brother cried from hunger due to Okobore Town's shortage of food while their mother Yame tried to calm them down. When Zoro, Kiku and Law arrived with the Treasure Ship of Provisions, Kinbo and his family were able to eat as much as they wanted.
